name: Debangshu Erikstad
role: Street midwife and unlicensed obstetric care provider
location: the Gray Zone, GLMZ — operates from a converted laundry unit at Burnside Pocket, near Pulaski and Chicago Ave
description:
Nova Erikstad is a broad-shouldered woman with deep ochre skin mapped by a lifetime of hard work — her forearms are dense with old burn scars from a chemical incident she doesn't discuss, and her hands are extraordinary: thick-knuckled, steady, perpetually chalked with the talc she uses to ease on examination gloves. Her hair is grown long and gathered in elaborate wrapping cloths she changes daily, a small vanity she insists upon. Bioluminescent threads have been tattooed along her collarbone in a pattern that pulses softly blue when her heart rate rises — a gift from a grateful patient who was a tattooist, and which Nova Erikstad considers mildly embarrassing but cannot bring herself to remove.

She is the gravitational center of three city blocks. Women come to her in the small hours, sometimes alone, sometimes holding each other up. Nova Erikstad never turns anyone away, works on a sliding scale that regularly bottoms out at zero, and maintains a mental ledger of every birth she has attended — over nine hundred. She has strong opinions about Helix Biosystems, none of them polite, and a practical theology around the E.L.F. she calls Thresholder, whom she believes watches over liminal moments: birth, death, the crossing between states. She leaves small data-offerings on a cracked tablet beside her examination table.

core_fears: Watching someone die because she lacked the right equipment
Becoming irrelevant or unable to practice
core_desires: For every child born on the Gray Zone to survive their first year
To be remembered as someone who showed up
coping_mechanisms: Ritual — precise, repeated actions before and after deliveries
Displacement into work whenever grief threatens to surface
blind_spots: Refuses to acknowledge her own physical deterioration and what it means for her patients
Believes she can assess risk accurately when she is emotionally involved with a patient
psychology.secret: She lost a patient and infant twelve years ago to a complication she might have caught earlier if she hadn't been exhausted from a triple shift. She told the family it was unpreventable. She has never told anyone the truth.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Warm and vernacular, mixes Igbo endearments with Tongan rhythmic phrases, medical terminology deployed precisely when needed and then immediately softened
speech_patterns.cadence: Slow and deliberate, like she's deciding each word has earned its place — accelerates only when directing emergency action
verbal_tics: Clicking her tongue once before delivering bad news
Referring to newborns as 'this one' until they are named
example_lines: 'Come now. The body knows what it's doing. You just need to stop arguing with it.'
'I've seen nine hundred and forty-three beginnings. This one is not going to be the one that breaks me. Not tonight.'

story_hooks: A birth she attended six months ago is now being investigated by Helix Biosystems — they claim the infant carries proprietary gene markers and constitutes Helix IP. Ogechi is refusing to cooperate and needs someone to make the investigators go away.
One of her regular patients has stopped coming to appointments and isn't responding to messages. Her neighbors say they haven't seen her in two weeks.
narrative_function: Community anchor and information node; knows the intimate secrets of hundreds of the Gray Zone families. Quest giver for anything involving missing mothers or children. Moral voice who challenges players' ethical shortcuts.
augmentations: Bioluminescent pulse tattoo along collarbone (cosmetic, involuntary — gifted). Subdermal haptic pads on fingertips for enhanced tactile diagnostics — older model, partially degraded.
daily_life: Rises before dawn to check on recent births and post-partum patients via encrypted message threads, spends afternoons doing prenatal checkups in her unit or in clients' homes, and keeps irregular evening hours for emergencies — which means she rarely sleeps a full night.
affiliation: Independent — loosely networked with Burnside Pocket community health cooperative

decision_rules: Patient welfare overrides everything else, including her own safety
Never give information about a patient to anyone without explicit consent — no exceptions
escalation_ladder: Firm refusal with no further elaboration
Physical interposition between threat and patient

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Reserved, evaluative — watches hands and eyes before speaking much

stress_responses.medium: Issues short, direct commands; ceases social niceties entirely
stress_responses.high: A terrible, focused calm — those who know her say this is when she is most frightening

contradictions: Preaches rest to patients while running herself into the ground
Claims she doesn't believe in fate but maintains meticulous superstitions around birth thresholds
habits: Rewraps her head cloth when anxious
Hums a low atonal sound while working — she doesn't realize she does this
Always positions herself between a patient and the door
breaking_points: A child dying while she is present and helpless

timeline.event: Born in Burnside Pocket to a Tongan logistics worker and a Nigerian-Ukrainian medic
Began apprenticing under an elder midwife in the cooperative
Chemical incident that caused forearm scarring — cause undisclosed
Lost a patient and infant; told the family it was unpreventable
Received bioluminescent tattoo from grateful patient

physical_description.heritage: Northern European foundation (48.7%) creates baseline bone structure and fair undertones, substantially enriched by Hispanic/Latin American ancestry (25.5%) contributing warm golden-bronze skin depth and fuller facial features, South Asian heritage (20.8%) adding definition to cheekbones and eye shape with deeper warm tones, and Southeast Asian ancestry (5.0%) contributing delicate refinement to facial proportions. The result is a genuinely multicultural phenotype: angular Northern European bone structure softened by Latin American warmth, complexion brightened by Southeast Asian delicacy, with South Asian depth creating striking contrast. This is not a pale baseline with additions—it is an integrated warm medium tone where all ancestries are visibly present.
physical_description.build: Broad-shouldered and dense, with the squared musculature of someone who has done physical labor for decades. Not overweight — solid, grounded, built to endure. Her frame suggests the kind of strength that comes from years of lifting, supporting, holding.
physical_description.hair_color: Natural black with scattered grey threads left unhidden
physical_description.hair_style: Gathered in elaborate wrapping cloths that change daily — currently indigo cotton with gold threadwork, pulled back from her face to expose her full forehead
physical_description.eye_color: Deep brown, slightly yellowed at the sclera from age and fatigue
physical_description.skin_tone: Medium warm bronze with golden undertones throughout—neither pale nor dark, but richly warm from the integrated blend of her ancestry. Sun-exposed and lived-in, suggesting years spent outdoors across diverse climates.
physical_description.complexion: Weathered but not aged poorly—her face is lined with expression rather than sagging. Broad, balanced cheekbones with defined structure reflecting her mixed heritage blend, complemented by a defined jawline. Full mouth often pressed into a thin line of concentration. Deep creases around her eyes from years of squinting in poor light and smiling. Her skin shows the texture of someone who does not prioritize cosmetic maintenance; pragmatic, clean, lived-in.
distinguishing_marks: Dense, pale burn scarring across both forearms from wrist to elbow — chemical incident origin, waxy and smooth with age, approximately 25 years old
Bioluminescent tattoo pattern along her collarbone: thin threads of cyan and deep blue that pulse softly in sync with her heartbeat when elevated, visible at the neckline of her usual clothing
Fine white scar on the back of her left hand, running from knuckle to wrist — old suture line, possibly occupational
physical_description.visible_augmentations: The bioluminescent collarbone tattoo is her only visibly augmented feature — a soft blue pulse visible when her heart rate rises. Her subdermal haptic fingertip pads are not visible but her hands bear the callused marks of someone who has relied on them for decades: slightly thickened fingertips, minor discoloration at the pad sites, a faint granulation visible under close inspection. She keeps her nails trimmed blunt and wears no jewelry on her hands except a plain silver wedding band (worn by her late spouse).
physical_description.posture_movement: Stands with her full weight distributed evenly, never leaning. Moves with deliberate slowness — economy of motion rather than tiredness. Her hands are always busy: gesturing, reaching, adjusting her head wraps. She has the stillness of someone trained to be present; when she stops moving to listen, the shift is noticeable. Her gait is steady but her shoulders sometimes roll forward from exhaustion.
physical_description.clothing_style: Practical, Tier 4 working-class aesthetic with personal touches. Typically wears loose cotton or linen tunics in earth tones (ochre, burnt orange, deep green) layered over fitted black leggings. Comfortable slip-on shoes, often scuffed. A long cardigan or shawl worn for warmth and to cover her scarred arms when meeting new patients. She favors natural fabrics and muted colors — nothing flashy, nothing corpo-coded. Her head wraps are her only concession to vanity: they are always clean, always intentional, often patterned with geometric designs. No visible jewelry except her wedding band and occasionally small beaded bracelets made by patients' children. She carries a worn canvas satchel with external pockets stuffed with latex gloves, swabs, and a battered tablet.
